basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Junior Project Assistant (Admin) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has released advertisement number IITD/IRD/IM00031G_RB-DE(CC)/353035/553268, notifying 1 vacancy for the post of Junior Project Assistant (Admin) on a contract basis under the 2026 recruitment drive. Candidates possessing a 3 year degree from a recognised university can apply for this position, which offers a consolidated pay of Rs. 29,290-Rs. 38,220 per month. plus HRA @ 30%. Eligible applicants should download Form No. IRD/REC-4 and send the duly filled application by email with the advertisement number on the subject line on or before 23 Octo

important_dates.raw: 08/10/2026 Last Date for Submitting Completed Applications: 23/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill up the form with complete information regarding educational qualifications, percentage of marks/division, details of work experience, etc.
Send the duly filled form by email to Smruti Ranjan Sarangi at email id: [email protected].
Mention advertisement number (IITD/IRD/IM00031G_RB-DE(CC)/353035/553268) on the subject line of the email.
Ensure complete application reaches by email on or before 23/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Junior Project Assistant (Admin) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
HPC Operations (IRD Reimbursable from Planning Unit) (IM00031G_RB_DE(CC))
Upto 31.05.2031 or yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier
Not stated in the notice (Relaxation of marks up to 5% may be granted to SC/ST candidates in case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Junior Project Assistant (Admin) post must fulfill the following essential and desirable qualifications:

rows.essential_qualification: B.Com (3 year degree) from a recognised university
rows.desirable_other_requirements: i) Working knowledge of office procedures, noting, drafting and official correspondence. ii) Good communication skills. iii) Minimum 1 year relevant experience in administration/establishment, accounts/stores, procurement, and meeting coordination. iv) Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. v) Working knowledge of accounting, GST, and TDS.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay ranging from Rs. 29,290 to Rs. 38,220 per month plus HRA @ 30%, starting at Rs. 29,290 - 30,170 - 31,080 - 32,010 - 32,970 - 33,960 - 34,930 - 36,030 - 37,100 - 38,220/- p.m. The duration of the project is up to 31.05.2031, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. For a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for an online interview, and their names will be displayed on the web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with the online interview details.
